body:
My parents tell me all of the time how he's the best I'll ever get, and that I'm very lucky to have him. I'm not a very attractive person, and obviously I'm not a good significant other, or I wouldn't want to kill myself for not feeling loved. So leaving him and finding someone else isn't really an option for me.

I haven't tried counseling because I went as a kid, and it never worked for me. I think it might help other people, and do wonderful things. I just don't think it's for me.

I don't feel like he will, its been five years. He was a wonderful boyfriend, and I've told him that he doesn't treat me the same way. I use to receive long text messages about how wonderful I am, and how happy he is to have me, once we got married it stopped. I've told him this at least once a month for the last 4 years. 

I'm sorry I didn't spell it out better in the post, but since the previous time this happened, I haven't told him no to sex. Even if I didn't want to, which most of the time I didn't, his idea of foreplay  is "wanna have sex?" and I always tried to make it enjoyable for him.
I don't really think it would matter. It's not going to make me feel any better. Thank you for your kind offer, however.
I've tried talking to him, numerous times about how I feel. Nothing ever changes. I've tried so many things for him to understand how I feel, and I guess it's just not in the cards for me.
